 Andy Cohen dishes on his latest sexy viral Speedo pics
 The handsome TV host is clearing the air on the revealing pics that are taking over the internet.
 Andy Cohen poses at Bravo Night on Broadway during "&Juliet" at The Stephen Sondheim Theatre.

 Follow:
 Twitter It's been a big year for Andy Cohen! The handsome TV host has continued to slay the game in all aspects of the entertainment industry.
 The mogul is celebrating 20 years of The Real Housewives of Bravo, creating plenty of viral moments on Watch What Happens Live , and chatting with the biggest celebrities on his hit SiriusXM radio show. Plus, he even confirmed a new relationship that has him swooning.
 Although he's thriving personally and professionally, Cohen created a ton of buzz over the summer for sexy new Speedo pics that rocked the internet. Sadly, it turns out that the photos were AI, but the Bravo exec poked fun at the photos during a recent appearance on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon .
 See on Instagram 
 Cohen admitted that many people complimented him on his impressive physique in the sexy photos, but he was quick to shut down the actual legitimacy of the pictures.
 "It's AI! That is not me. Do you think that I'm going to wear a micro bikini with no genitalia whatsoever? Who do you think I am? You've seen me in swim trunks. I don't wear Speedos," Cohen says.
 Fallon was quick to shut Cohen down by pulling out an old Cohen rocking a Speedo in his younger years while mowing his lawn.
 Since Cohen was able to laugh at the fake Speedo pics over the summer, we'll cure your curiosity by including the photos below. Enjoy!
